MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable SSD feels useful alongside my older desktop external drive because it offers a convenient way to carry and transfer files.",
    "The HDMI switch connects two things I already use—a streaming device and a Blu-ray player—and would save me from swapping cables.",
    "The Echo Show and Alexa-compatible cameras fit my existing Alexa setup, even though fitting that setup alone does not give me a reason to buy them now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV Stick duplicates a need my recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers, and another Echo Show is less compelling after my recent Show 5 and stand.",
    "The enterprise hard drive and internal SSD do not follow from my use of external storage: I want convenient storage, and I have no planned internal upgrade or confirmed compatibility.",
    "The headphones, five short charging cables, and separate microphone lack a clear current purpose for me; my webcam already includes a microphone, and the camera bundle would require a need for multiple cameras."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa purchases seem to be taken as a reason to suggest more Alexa devices, without enough attention to which needs I have already filled.",
    "My storage and computer-accessory purchases seem to be treated as interest in broadly related equipment, although portability, connections, and a specific use matter more to me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they can resolve a need: getting a newer streaming device or a smart display makes another similar device less useful right now.",
    "Several of my purchases support equipment I already own, such as replacement remote batteries and the Show stand. Accessories that solve a concrete problem with that equipment feel more relevant than additions with no established purpose."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in practical electronics and Alexa devices, but sometimes confuse a related product with something I currently need."
}
